items.text: One sentence choice: cards, Swap, your list and the journey pick from your whole library.
Length now defaults to 14–25 characters; a length you chose yourself is kept.
Generate a quarter to a third faster, with less memory: 15.0 → 11.5 s on 2,000 files.
A big library opens to its numbers sooner (5.3 → 3.6 s on 20,000 files), with no long pauses.
Make my new cards again…: cards you never studied are made again, a copy kept, with Put back….
Send report is one easy button: a note, flagged sentences, swaps or cards you didn't want.
A book with no audiobook makes a sentence card, never an audio card with nothing to play.
Best's mine without the speech model no longer ends with 0 cards.
Sort again and Put back work while Connect is only waiting.
A long show name fits the journey's rail, the full name on hover.
The old journey page and Zen are retired: a saved Zen look opens the new page in Night.
